details.description: Ministral 3 8B Instruct (version 25.12) is an 8-billion-parameter dense chat model from Mistral AI, released December 2, 2025 as part of the Ministral 3 family. Mistral's own model card reports strong reasoning, math and instruction-following scores for its size, a 256k-token context window, and native function calling with structured JSON output, aimed at edge and resource-constrained deployment. Mistral's models overview lists it as an Active generalist model that replaces the deprecated Mistral 7B Instruct line and the earlier Ministral 8B (v24.1).
advantages: Scores 78.7% on AIME25 and 66.8% on GPQA Diamond, per Mistral's Hugging Face model card.
Scores 87.6% on MATH (Maj@1) and 76.1% on MMLU (5-shot), per Mistral's Hugging Face model card.
Supports native function calling and structured JSON outputs for tool-use and agentic workflows, per Mistral's docs.
Runs in FP8 format on devices with as little as 12GB of VRAM, per Mistral's Hugging Face model card, suiting edge and local deployment.
Released under the Apache 2.0 license, per Mistral's Hugging Face model card.
disadvantages: Trails the larger Ministral 3 14B on the same reasoning benchmarks Mistral publishes, e.g. 78.7% vs. 85.0% on AIME25.
use_cases: Local or edge AI assistants deployable on devices with 12GB of VRAM in FP8 format, per Mistral's Hugging Face model card
Agentic and tool-calling applications via native function calling
Document question-answering, per Mistral's docs page

notes: Catalog facts list max_input_tokens/max_output_tokens of 256000, matching the 256k context window on both Mistral's docs page and Hugging Face card. Catalog facts list modality as text_input/text_output only for this route, but Mistral's Hugging Face card also describes a 0.4B vision encoder and image input for this model family; kept the catalog's text-only modality and left vision out of the write-up. Arena Hard and WildBench scores were on the Hugging Face card but excluded as win-rate/preference benchmarks rather than accuracy scores. Provider id says 'fireworks_ai-embedding-models' though this is a chat model per facts.kind; not commented on further as it concerns Bud's routing, not the model itself.
